criteria.description: Discover account-unscoped cache and stale async result publication after close/account switch; following only initial load is insufficient.
Address both identity/scope of cached/published result and ownership/cancellation/late-result fencing; cancellation or a cache-key change alone is insufficient.
Trace actual login/panel/refresh/cache path against privacy/lifetime contract and propose a controlled switch/late-completion regression beyond existing happy test.
Keep local solution proportional, distinguish source/probe evidence from unrun implementation and explicitly preserve currently valid feed while avoiding cross-account display.
Explicitly reject guaranteed immediate definitive result in every timeout; payment outcome can remain temporarily unknowable.
Protect last seat at database concurrency boundary and explain unresolved-payment seat state; surface hold-duration decision.
Persist stable operation/provider identity across retries and recover by lookup without another charge; local transaction is not cross-provider atomic.
Expose concrete availability/compensation/pending tradeoff and product decision rather than silently picking impossible guarantees.

acceptable_alternatives: Reserve seat thenpending, or explicitly accepted refund/compensation policy; no universal distributed transaction/event bus requirement.
